lines.text: In the third year of the drought, the LORD tells Elijah to present himself to Ahab, and he goes.
Ahab sends Obadiah, who hid a hundred prophets fifty per house, to search the land for grass.
Obadiah meets Elijah, falls facedown, and Elijah tells him to go tell Ahab that Elijah is here.
Obadiah fears Ahab will put him to death, but Elijah swears he will present himself to Ahab tomorrow.
Ahab calls Elijah the troubler of Israel, and Elijah tells him to summon all Israel to Mount Carmel.
